newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pinnacle estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pinnacle estimates cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Doug van Dorsten has cut earnings estimates for Pinnacle Systems Inc after the company predicted a greater-than-expected revenue shortfall for the December quarter.

-- He cut his December quarter (the company's fiscal Q2) estimate to a loss of $0.39/shr from a loss of $0.05/shr. He reduced his forecast for fiscal 1997 ending June 30, 1997 to a loss of $0.55/shr from a profit of $0.43/shr.
-- Weakness in demand for its Aladdin product from customer Avid Technology Inc and softness in other product lines led to the revenue shortfall.
